assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square game dialogue sign portrait for PokeAether, readable as a small 256px illustration. Front three-quarter view, building and entrance fill the composition, clear silhouette. Rich hand-painted anime environment illustration, crisp painterly detail, bright blue sky and soft summer daylight, welcoming but disciplined ninja-dojo character. Match the polished illustrated town-sign portrait aesthetic, not pixel art. No people, no Pokémon, no lettering, no UI, no border, no watermark. Opaque background.
